title: Travel without worries
tagline: Insured, connected and through security fast.
trigger: A flight or holiday booking was paid.

steps.title: Travel insurance
steps.description: Cover for medical costs, cancellation and luggage for this trip.
steps.why: KBC sees the booking, so the dates are already filled in.
steps.result: Travel insurance active for your trip to {destination}.

steps.title: Your card ready for abroad
steps.description: Limits checked for your trip, card active outside Europe if needed, Apple Pay on.
steps.why: Settings you can change yourself in KBC Mobile.

win.customer: No blocked card at the hotel desk

steps.result: Card limits checked for your trip. Apple Pay is on.

steps.title: Mobile data without roaming bills
steps.description: A travel eSIM for your destination, installed before you leave.
steps.why: It only needs your destination and dates.
steps.result: eSIM for {destination} ready: 10 GB, installs in one tap.

steps.title: Fast Lane at Brussels Airport
steps.description: Skip the security queue on departure day.
steps.why: It only needs your name and date.

win.customer: A calm start of the holiday
